conf.description: PACS Badge System (OnGuard Lnl_LoggedEvent class exemplar) door-alarm-events / api-pull: same Time/event.id/event.code decode as access-events, but event.outcome is derived from the alarm description (AccessResult is always NotApplicable on alarm records), hash CardNumber, leave Priority and Lnl_Reader.Name unmapped.

conf.comment: pacs-badge / door-alarm-events / api-pull. Shares the access-events collector and vendor-normalization approach; branch differs because AccessResult is NotApplicable(4) on every alarm record, so event.outcome is derived from the normalized event.action text instead, per recommendations.direct.cribl. Priority is left unmapped: the map itself calls it a placeholder with no confirmed field name or numeric range for this vendor. Lnl_Reader.Name requires a join with no lookup CSV available - unmapped, see README. The recommendation also asks this pipeline to split the shared collector's stream by Type/SubType; the map supplies no concrete numeric values to do that with, so this pipeline assumes upstream delivers already-alarm-scoped events - see README gap.

functions.description: if the REST collector delivered raw JSON text, parse it; a collector that already emits structured fields leaves this a no-op

compute every derived field from the ORIGINAL vendor names before the rename below touches them: parse Time to _time, concatenate PanelID+SerialNumber into event.id, normalize Description into event.action, concatenate Type+SubType into event.code, derive event.outcome from the normalized action text (NOT AccessResult - it is NotApplicable on this dataset), tag category/dataset
hash the badge/card number of the read that preceded the alarm, where one is present, before it is renamed into pacs.badge.card_number
redact the same card number if it still sits in _raw as JSON text (no-op if the collector never preserved a raw string or the alarm has no preceding read)
batch every clean-path field that is a straight copy to its ECS or custom target, run after the compute step and after CardNumber is already hashed
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
